root_cause.text: In __split_huge_pmd_locked(), the file/shmem RSS counter update via mm_counter_file() is performed after folio_put(), which can read freed folio state (folio_test_swapbacked()) when folio_put() drops the last reference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the add_mm_counter() call before folio_put() and adds an early return, as described in the commit message: "If folio_put() drops the last reference, mm_counter_file() can later read freed folio state via folio_test_swapbacked()."

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: In __split_huge_pmd_locked(), the file/shmem RSS counter update via mm_counter_file() is performed after folio_put(), which can read freed folio state (folio_test_swapbacked()) when folio_put() drops the last reference.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch moves the add_mm_counter() call before folio_put() and adds an early return, as described in the commit message: "If folio_put() drops the last reference, mm_counter_file() can later read freed folio state via folio_test_swapbacked()."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a use-after-free bug in __split_huge_pmd_locked by moving the mm counter decrement before folio_put and adding an early return to prevent accessing the freed folio.
intent_record.what: Added an add_mm_counter call and a return statement inside an if block in __split_huge_pmd_locked, moving the file-page counter decrement before folio_put and preventing fall-through to the outer code that would also decrement the counter (and access the folio after it may be freed).
intent_record.how: This fixes a use-after-free bug: previously, for file-backed folios that entered the if block, folio_put could free the folio, and then the subsequent add_mm_counter (outside the if block) would access the freed folio. Now the counter is adjusted while the folio is still alive, and the function returns immediately, avoiding the use-after-free.

grouping_result.intent: Fix a use-after-free bug in __split_huge_pmd_locked by moving the mm counter decrement before folio_put and adding an early return to prevent accessing the freed folio.

relevance_review.reason: The group's core intent directly addresses the use-after-free vulnerability in __split_huge_pmd_locked by moving the mm counter decrement before folio_put, which matches the root cause's description of the bug.

candidates.rationale: mm_counter_file(folio) reads folio_test_swapbacked() from the folio after folio_put() may have freed it, causing a use-after-free when decrementing the RSS counter.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement calls mm_counter_file(folio) after folio_put() may have freed the folio, causing a use-after-free when accessing folio_test_swapbacked() to update the RSS counter.
